title: 📱 Motorola teases a new Razr Fold phone the size of a passport — a rival to the iPhone Duo!
body: 📱 Motorola teases a new Razr Fold phone the size of a passport — a rival to the iPhone Duo!
Motorola has begun teasing a new model of its foldable Razr Fold phone, which could launch soon in selected global markets.
The new phone comes in a passport-like form: a shorter, wider body than typical foldables, according to the teaser video the company published.
The phone appears in the video in black, which may be a camouflage cover hiding the finer design details, though its shape looks close to its rivals in the same category.
The phone is expected to compete with Apple's first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, and Samsung's upcoming Galaxy Z Fold 8.
Motorola has not yet revealed the specifications, the price, or the exact launch date, sticking to teasing the new design.
The tease comes weeks after the current Razr Fold began receiving the Android 17 update in selected markets.
Simply put: after years of long, slim phones, Motorola is trying a shorter, wider passport-like shape; could the wide foldable become the new favorite form?
Would you prefer a short, wide foldable phone or a long, slim one?
